name: Spotorno (Italy)
description: Vertical bicolour of white and blue, charged at the centre with the crowned municipal arms of Spotorno (a castle on blue beneath two birds) within branches.
history: Municipal flag of Spotorno, a comune in Liguria; Italian municipal arms, gonfaloni and flags are granted by decree of the President of the Republic on the advice of the Government's heraldry office.

features.role: Spotorno arms — castle on blue beneath two birds, crowned, within branches
